constraints: Do not change the behavior of POST /api/v1/urls.
Include an impact analysis of modules, APIs, and data flow.

acceptance: the body accepts 1 to 20 http or https urls and the response lists a code for each item. A javascript scheme inside the batch is rejected.
functional_requirements.statement: Create many links in one call with POST /api/v1/urls/bulk.

out_of_scope: A background import from a CSV file.
problem_statement: The shortener already creates one link per request. Callers need to create a batch without changing the single-create API.
title: Bulk link creation
